_about: Region 5 (cases 41–50, Lake Victoria and western Kenya). New image descriptions for every person, place and object exhibit that had none. Apply with  npm run images:briefs -- prompts/briefs/region-05.json .

people.p_benta: Kenyan woman, late 50s, a faded headscarf, a cardigan over a kitenge, a thermos under her arm, knowing and warm, ID-photo framing
people.p_seline: Kenyan woman, late 30s, braids under a headwrap, a fish trader's apron, gumboots, grieving and angry, ID-photo framing
people.p_fanuel: Kenyan man, late 20s, a reflective boda vest with no writing over a hoodie, a helmet on his arm, relaxed, ID-photo framing
people.p_maurice: Kenyan man, mid 40s, a weathered fisherman's jacket, a woollen hat, rough hands, proud of his catch, ID-photo framing

ev_net.brief: a woven basket brimming with small wet silver fish standing beside an empty drying net laid out on the sand at a lake landing in early morning, nothing spread on the net

evidence.ev_engine: an outboard boat engine on a wooden stand, freshly sprayed grey with a patch of the old colour showing at an edge, a small metal serial plate, close-up

people.p_diana: Kenyan woman, late 30s, a white public-health officer's coat with no badge, a clipboard, short natural hair, determined, ID-photo framing
people.p_hassan: Kenyan man, late 40s, a plain dust coat, a receipt book and a rubber stamp in his hands, a kofia, officious, ID-photo framing
people.p_rebecca: Kenyan woman, mid 50s, a headscarf, a cook's apron over a dress, a shopping basket, plain-spoken, ID-photo framing
people.p_lilian: Kenyan woman, about 40, braids, a denim jacket, a handbag, attentive, ID-photo framing

evidence.ev_stack: the top of a stack of white 50 kg sugar sacks in a market store, fresh tears pulled in the woven plastic of the top three sacks, sugar trickling out, close-up
evidence.ev_backroom: a cramped back room of a market shop, bales of new empty printed sugar sacks, a sack-sewing machine half covered by a cloth, a pile of torn-open foreign sugar bags on the floor, a bare bulb
evidence.ev_sarah_prints: a police ten-print fingerprint card on a station desk, ten inked fingerprints in their boxes, an ink roller beside it, the name box out of focus

people.p_rispa: Kenyan woman, late 40s, a headscarf, a cardigan over a print dress, a sharp listening face, ID-photo framing
people.p_owen: Kenyan man, mid 30s, a short-sleeved shirt and a cap, a thick logbook under his arm, a pen behind his ear, sociable, ID-photo framing
people.p_selpher: Kenyan woman, about 50, a headscarf tied tight, a black shawl over a dress, newly widowed and composed, ID-photo framing
people.p_paul: Kenyan man, mid 50s, a frayed sweater, a net needle in his fingers, a weathered calm face, ID-photo framing
people.p_choirleader: Kenyan woman, early 60s, a church choir robe in purple over a blouse, a hymn book held to her chest, stern and kind, ID-photo framing

evidence.ev_battery: a heavy 12-volt solar battery with a carrying handle lying on its side on a shop's concrete floor, one corner of the casing scuffed and marked, close-up
evidence.ev_path: a narrow rocky footpath at night lit by a torch beam, winding down between bushes on an island hillside towards a faint jetty light on the water

people.p_oyugi: Kenyan man, about 70, a battered felt hat, an old army-green coat, a sling for scaring birds over his shoulder, a deeply lined patient face, ID-photo framing
people.p_clement: Kenyan man, late 30s, a short-sleeved office shirt, a ballpoint in the pocket, a careful look that says less than he knows, ID-photo framing
people.p_pamela: Kenyan woman, early 50s, a headscarf, a kanga over her dress, a water jerrycan handle in her hand, early-morning tired, ID-photo framing
people.p_kevin: Kenyan man, mid 30s, a leather jacket, a small notebook of prices, a trader's quick eyes, ID-photo framing

ev_inlet.brief: a square-edged wooden inlet gate on a rice paddy bund, lifted about halfway, brown water running through, a short-handled jembe lying intact on the bund beside it, dawn light

ev_trail.brief: a wide strip of flattened rice plants running from a paddy edge down into a muddy canal, no footprints in the mud, untouched rice on both sides

evidence.ev_log: a heavy wet log lying at the edge of a rice paddy, its underside caked thick with fresh black clay, close-up
evidence.ev_canalmud: a clear evidence bag of sticky black cotton-soil clay held over a canal bank, close-up
evidence.ev_violet_house: a wrap skirt hanging damp on a line with a dark mud line in the hem stitching, and a jembe blade without a handle wrapped in a cloth on a granary floor, splintered wood in its socket

people.p_sabina: Kenyan woman, about 50, a housekeeper's plain dress and apron, a headscarf, a bunch of household keys, loyal and frightened, ID-photo framing
people.p_tom: Kenyan man, early 40s, a white steward's jacket with no badge, a bow tie, a bill folder in his hand, discreet, ID-photo framing
people.p_wycliffe: Kenyan man, late 30s, a driver's dark suit and tie, car keys in his hand, neutral and careful, ID-photo framing

evidence.ev_priya_prints: a police ten-print fingerprint card on a desk, ten inked fingerprints in rows, an ink pad and roller beside it, the name box out of focus

people.p_japheth: Kenyan man, late 20s, a torn football shirt with no badge, a cap backwards, salt-cracked hands, uneasy, ID-photo framing
people.p_rose: Kenyan woman, mid 50s, a headscarf, a plain cardigan, a ruled register under her arm, orderly, ID-photo framing
people.p_dorcas: Kenyan woman, about 30, braids tied up, a kitenge blouse, a baby sling strap on one shoulder, defensive, ID-photo framing

evidence.ev_vbeach: a clear evidence bag of plain grey volcanic grit held over a grey lake beach, close-up
evidence.ev_compound: behind a small house: a wooden canoe paddle with a fresh crack along the blade, scrubbed pale, leaning against a wall above a grit path with a distinct red volcanic layer

noPhoto.ev_party: Other people's party photos: shown as the frame times so they stay exact.

people.p_fidelis: Kenyan man, about 30, headphones round his neck, a bright shirt under a black jacket, red-eyed from an all-night funeral disco, ID-photo framing
people.p_turfosa: Kenyan woman, mid 50s, a headscarf, a big apron streaked with soot, smoke-tired eyes, commanding, ID-photo framing
people.p_maureen: Kenyan woman, mid 20s, braids under a scarf, a kitenge dress, soot on her cheek, exhausted, ID-photo framing

evidence.ev_pestle: a long wooden pounding pestle lying in tall grass behind a mud-walled store at dawn, close-up

ev_maize.brief: the inside of a mud-walled maize store with an iron roof, a gap where four sacks stood, drag marks in the dust from the door, and outside a wooden handcart dusted with maize flour

evidence.ev_mitchelle_home: a small dish on a bedside shelf holding a broken red-and-white beaded bracelet, a black dress on a hanger behind it with grass seeds caught in the hem, close-up

people.p_boke: Kenyan woman, about 30, a headscarf, a torn overall smeared with red earth, a headlamp round her neck, tough and wary, ID-photo framing
people.p_nyakerario: Kenyan woman, early 50s, a headscarf, a cardigan, a school exercise book used as a log, sharp-eyed, ID-photo framing
people.p_chacha: Kenyan man, mid 30s, a hard hat, red earth on his overalls, a coil of rope on his shoulder, tough, ID-photo framing
people.p_magige: Kenyan man, late 40s, a smart jacket over a polo shirt, a small set of scales in a box, a dealer's smile, ID-photo framing

evidence.ev_refweight: a tiny certified 1-gram reference weight in a small clear plastic case with a school label, on a wooden table, close-up

ev_prop.brief: the mouth of a hand-dug mine shaft in red earth, rotten grey timber props, one solid prop lying across the opening with fresh stone-strike marks at its base

evidence.ev_rimclay: a clear evidence bag of dark red clay held against the rim of a mine shaft cut in red earth, close-up

people.p_norah: Kenyan woman, late 30s, a plain fisheries officer's khaki shirt with no badge, a cool box strap, a notebook, businesslike, ID-photo framing
people.p_hamisi: Kenyan man, late 20s, a bright vest, a small blank menu board under his arm, a quick grin gone uneasy, ID-photo framing
people.p_everlyne: Kenyan woman, early 30s, a hairnet, a stained cook's apron, a tired face from a hot kitchen, ID-photo framing

ev_hook.brief: a wall of kitchen tools hanging on hooks above charcoal stoves, every handle wrapped with red tape, one hook empty in the row

people.p_lorna: Kenyan woman, early 30s, short natural hair, a denim jacket, a reporter's notebook and a phone, determined, ID-photo framing
people.p_mary: Kenyan woman, about 60, a headscarf, a black shawl over a dress, newly widowed, ID-photo framing
people.p_consolata: Kenyan woman, late 50s, a headscarf, a cardigan, a small notebook held in both hands, grieving and resolute, ID-photo framing
people.p_mamakioko: Kenyan woman, about 50, a printed headscarf, a sweater, arms folded, protective of her son, ID-photo framing
